## Triage: first touch → `domain:skills` (lead) · p2 · `pm:queue` · 2026-11-14T23:47Z

⛔ Not a claim.

AI build adds a user field labelled 「负责人」 next to the system `owner_id` with the same label. Users then cannot tell which one they are changing, and only `owner_id` drives record visibility. That is a real user surface (staging AI build), and a wrong edit leaves access different from what the user meant, so **p2**.
- Authoring rule (skills, the lead): when a request names an owner or assignee, reuse `owner_id`, or pick a label that does not collide.
- Build check: report two visible fields with the same label as an error. This belongs to the build validation lane (spec/server). Split it out if the skills seat prefers not to carry it.
